requirements.title: Eligibility
requirements.summary: Eligible colleges are Ivan Allen Liberal Arts, Engineering, Scheller Business and Sciences; catalog directs students to the minor website for up-to-date eligible majors and advisers.

requirements.title: Whole-track rule
requirements.summary: Students must choose a complete track and may not mix track requirements. Discuss compatibility with the academic adviser.

requirements.title: Research credit
requirements.summary: Research must address AI/ML and receive designated unit approval; no more than 3 hours may count as an elective.

requirements.title: BMED2400 alternative prerequisites
requirements.summary: Ivan Allen and Scheller students taking Engineering-track BMED2400 may satisfy its prerequisites with MATH1712 plus CS1315 or CS1301.

requirements.title: Scheller programming prerequisite
requirements.summary: The Scheller track requires CS1301 or an approved equivalent programming course as prerequisite for AI in Business.

requirements.title: School breadth
requirements.summary: Take at least two courses outside the home school and courses from at least two schools. Cross-listed courses are not outside the home school for students in any cross-listing school.

requirements.title: Grade and level minima
requirements.summary: Every minor course needs C or better; at least 9 credits must be at 3000 level or higher.

requirements.title: Overlap restrictions
requirements.summary: No minor course may count toward another undergraduate minor or certificate. Major overlap follows Institute restrictions without additional minor restrictions.

requirements.title: Major overlap and core restriction
requirements.summary: Major/minor overlap is allowed by default unless the specific minor imposes breadth restrictions; Core IMPACTS courses cannot count.

requirements.title: Letter grading
requirements.summary: All minor courses require letter grades and C or better.

requirements.title: Declaration and award
requirements.summary: Declare no later than applying for graduation. Minor and major are conferred together and recorded on the transcript; the minor is not on the diploma and cannot be awarded retroactively.

requirements.title: Neuroscience subject-catalog cross-check
requirements.summary: NEUR 3803 is Special Topics in Neuroscience (3 catalog credit hours); NEUR 4740 is Neuroethics (3 catalog credit hours). These individual course identities support a discrepancy review but do not establish the intended minor cross-listing or topic. The conflicting minor row is retained pending advising clarification.

requirements.title: Competing program-site neuroscience wording
requirements.summary: The program site lists the computational-cognitive-neuroscience topic under NEUR/PSYC 3803 and Neuroethics under NEUR/PSYC 4740. The catalog minor row combines NEUR 4740/PSYC 3803 with that topic. This records both source statements without rewriting catalog eligibility.

notes: Every displayed track and pool is mapped, but ambiguous neuroscience topic/cross-list wording prevents a complete audit. Named topics are separate IDs; placeholderXXXX4699 research is a policy option, not a fabricated course. General permission to share 3 credits with another minor is superseded by this minor’s total prohibition on other-minor/certificate overlap.

The official program website was read via the robots-aware client after the web reader returned a gateway error. Its curriculum page resolves likely intended neuroscience labels but conflicts with catalog rows; no silent correction made. Its general no-extra-overlap wording also differs from the catalog’s explicit prohibition on other-minor/certificate reuse; the catalog restriction is retained.

2026-10-11: NEUR catalog confirms 3803 Special Topics and 4740 Neuroethics, but does not resolve the minor topic/cross-list mismatch. The overview still names four colleges while the advising roster omits Sciences; no ineligibility is inferred from omission.
